description: This file contains the configuration for the OpenAPI documentation in the cart-service module of the Shopizer project. It defines the OpenAPI metadata such as title, description, version, and tags for API endpoints related to cart management and health checks.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up OpenAPI specifications for the cart service, including metadata and tag information.

methods.name: cartOpenApi
methods.description: Defines and returns an OpenAPI object with metadata and tags tailored for the cart-service API.
